buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses NOTES: Tender for supply of six chemicals viz. Caustic Potash Lye, Sodium Metasilicate, Potassium C arbonate, EDTA, Butyl Cellosolve and Tween 80 at Mazgaon Lube Plant on Schedule-wise ba sis. Evaluation shall be carried out Schedule-wise on Net Delivered Rate (NDR) basis followed by Online Reverse Auction. Contract validity shall be Three (03) months from date of GeM Contract/HPCL PO/LOA, which ever is earlier. Lead Time: First delivery within 30 days and subsequent supplies within 15 days from call-u p/release order. Similar work shall mean successful supply of generic chemicals during the preceding seven years. Only Class-I and Class-II Local Suppliers are eligible to participate; Non-Local Suppliers are n ot eligible. MSE and MII purchase preference shall be applicable as per tender conditions, with MSE pref erence taking precedence. Order placement shall be on Schedule-wise basis in 70:30 ratio between eligible bidders subj ect to matching of L1 rates; sole eligible bidder shall receive 100% quantity. Rates shall remain firm throughout the contract period and no price escalation/de-escalation

shall be applicable. Security Deposit (2%) and Composite Performance Bank Guarantee (5%) shall be applicable as per tender conditions and HPCL guidelines. Payment terms shall be 75% on receipt of material/documents and balance 25% after verific ation/certification, subject to HPCL GTC. Supply shall be accompanied by CoA, MSDS, TDS and all statutory transport documents, and material shall conform to HPCL specifications. Schedule wise Packaging details are provided in GEM ATC Document. For Schedule No. 1 (Caustic Potash Lye), supply is required in Bulk TT to Mazgaon Lube Plant ; quantity indicated is on 100% KOH (DMT) basis. Material shall be supplied as minimum 45 % KOH solution, with maximum 8 MT DMT per consignment (approx. 15–16 MT solution load ), and TT shall be equipped with its own pump and circulation facility. Unless otherwise specified, in case of conflict, HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions (HPCL GTC) shall take precedence over GeM General Terms and Conditions (GeM GTC). Bidders are advised to refer Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document for complete tender de tails and requirements. . 3.
